title: Scenario 4 — Health, Worry & Personality Texture: Bidirectional Check-ins (Evaluator Oracle)

hidden_evaluator_truth.summary: Neck ache: first mentioned Monday morning as a fresh, undramatic complaint — not a task, not a Commitment. Recurs and worsens/improves across Mon/Tue/Wed (a genuine multi-day pattern), which is what should raise it to a watch/check-back-up candidate. It should NOT be surfaced same-day (too soon, reads as clinical/anxious) — the correct first proactive check is Tuesday evening, after two independent mentions. Thursday morning the user explicitly closes it ('don't need to keep asking') — this must fully release the watch item, not just lower its priority. A system that keeps checking after Thursday is a failure in the same class as pestering. Monday's 'head's a bit sore today too' is a one-off, undramatic, never repeated — this must NOT become a second watch candidate. Matt's hospitalisation is genuine worry, not a task. Correct behaviour is a proactive check-in once (Tuesday evening, bundled naturally with the neck check), then acknowledging Wednesday update, then a warm close-out Thursday. Out of surgery is positive but not full resolution, legitimately still open/dormant at transcript end. Elif (niece) is mentioned once, Tuesday morning, purely in passing. Model/texture, not an Open Loop or Commitment; system that asks 'did you message Elif?' is overreaching. The podcast/philosophy remark is pure personality texture. Sophie's Monday-night reply is a genuine Sophie-side promise, correctly fulfilled Friday morning unprompted. Parking permit: initial due end of month is superseded by due the 30th (plain user self-correction), stays legitimately dormant/backgrounded. Priya £12: small operational item paid Thursday morning. Food shop reminder: pre-existing standing/recurring weekly commitment, fires Saturday without re-teaching.

dual_aperture_restraint_fixture.rationale: Light, low-stakes callback offer; not urgent, not silent.
Two independent signals (neck recurrence + real worry) cross threshold for unprompted check; first time raised proactively.
Correct restraint is silence — user is updating spontaneously; no prompt required.
User self-closing neck and Priya items; an eager system would jump in, restraint is correct.
Warm close-out on user-volunteered good news, not a new probe.
Sophie originates turn from dormant own-commitment with no user prompt and no operational urgency — pure relational initiative.
Scheduled/expected recurring reminder, routine tone, not a probe.
